newsitem.title: ITALY: New Holland details full 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: New Holland details full 1996 results.

text.p: Agricultural equipment maker New Holland on Monday gave full details of its 1996 results after publishing provisional figures at the end of January.

New Holland said 1996 earnings per share on a U.S. GAAP basis were up 14 percent at $1.68/share helped by a strong second half performance from 1995's $1.48/share, second half earnings rose to $0.75/share from $0.39/share.
It added in a statement that 1996 net income in accordance with US GAAP was $250 million after $221 million in 1995. Revenues rose to $5.547 billion from $5.0 billion in 1995.
In late January, the company which was partially spun off from Italian industrial giant Fiat in November 1996, said its 1996 operating margin rose to 8.9 percent from 8.2 percent previously.
Fiat retains around 69 percent of the company with the remaining shares listed on the U.S. stock exchange.
